def transform(g):
    n=len(g)
    cols=[[g[i][j] for i in range(n)] for j in range(n)]
    q=[(j%3) if (j//3)%2==0 else 2-(j%3) for j in range(3*n)]

    return [tile(cols[q[i]]) for i in range(3*n)]
